title: Take delivery jobs
intro: Here's how to take delivery jobs from sellers on Shopinbos.

steps.caption: New jobs land in Jobs
steps.vo: When a seller books you, the job shows up in Jobs, under New.

steps.caption: Check what you get
steps.vo: Tap a job to see where to pick up, where to deliver, and what you get. If it's pay on delivery, it shows how much cash to collect.

steps.caption: Accept and pick a rider
steps.vo: Tap Accept and pick a rider. The closest free riders come first. Choose one, then tap Accept and send them.

steps.caption: Follow it in Active
steps.vo: Accepted jobs move to Active, so you can see every delivery that's on the way.

steps.caption: Move it along
steps.vo: Open a job and tap the green button at each step, like Mark as in transit. If something goes wrong, tap Report a failed attempt.

steps.caption: Finish with the code
steps.vo: At the door, enter the customer's delivery code. They got four digits by SMS and WhatsApp. No code? Use a photo instead.

outro: Keep Taking jobs switched on, and new jobs will keep coming in.
